task.title: Define RED tests for CLI poll, decrypt, history, and acknowledgement
task.description: Create failing Vitest specifications for signed mailbox polling, trusted sender decryption, atomic inbox/history persistence, duplicate suppression, and ack-after-commit retry semantics.
task.scope: apps/cli inbound messaging and history tests only

acceptance_criteria: Poll creates and signs a mailbox challenge using the stable local device, then validates strict relay responses.
Each envelope must match an imported sender identity/device pin before any Signal session or history mutation.
Successful decrypt commits Signal session changes, inbox deduplication, and plaintext history in one encrypted transaction before acknowledgement.
Decrypt or persistence failure sends no ack and leaves the envelope retriable; ack timeout retains durable pending-ack state.
Retry after ack timeout or process restart sends ack without decrypting again or duplicating history.
Duplicate envelopes do not advance the session twice or duplicate history; malformed ciphertext and changed sender identity fail closed.
History returns stable chronological inbound/outbound entries only from encrypted storage and JSON/diagnostic output redacts secrets.
constraints: Load and follow tests-creator and the project testing skill; preserve RED-before-GREEN evidence.
Read the completed T24 implementation/result when available before finalizing APIs and fixtures.
Do not write implementation code or weaken existing tests.
Do not edit flow.json or acceptance-criteria.md; do not modify apps/relay or shared package implementation.
Use keryx ctx rg for searches and apply_patch for edits.
Use real encrypted SQLite and official Signal objects for transaction/deduplication tests; fake only the HTTP boundary and injected persistence failure.
Do not commit because the repository has an unborn untracked baseline.
Write and validate a subagent-result to .metaproject/flows/001-2026-09-05-echolet-assessment-fixes/dispatches/001-T25-tests-result.json; final response starts STATUS:.

provenance.source_request: Implement the approved Echolet CLI prototype through flow-orchestrator.
